svg.aria-label: Architecture diagram: GitHub triggers an Azure DevOps pipeline (Validate, BuildAndPush, DeployDev, SmokeTest, E2ETest — the latter four gated to runs on the main branch only, not just non-PR builds) that reads secrets from Key Vault, authenticates to AKS as the least-privilege ci-deployer ServiceAccount, and pushes images through ACR. Inside the AKS cluster, ingress-nginx and cert-manager terminate TLS in front of the Angular client, whose nginx now routes every /api call through a YARP API Gateway — with active health-checked routing and the same shared exception handling as the backend services — which forwards to TicketService, ResponseService, and NotificationService. The three backend services exchange events only through RabbitMQ, with tiered retry, redelivery, and circuit-breaking. Container Insights streams logs and metrics to Log Analytics.
svg.text: BuildAndPush / DeployDev / SmokeTest / E2ETest run only for Build.SourceBranch == main, and never on PRs
port 5100 — active health checks per cluster,
shared exception handling with the services below
tiered retry → delayed redelivery → circuit breaker → dead-letter (_error queue)
Every service — including the gateway — shares one exception hierarchy and a tiered MassTransit fault-handling pipeline (docs/distributed-resilience.md).
The pipeline deploys as the least-privilege ci-deployer ServiceAccount, never the cluster-admin credential AKS hands out by default.
